memories.title: complexChange概览对齐complex页
memories.content: 原`zhi2-web-admin/src/views/property/complexChange/detail.vue`区域概览样式与`complex/detail.vue`不一致。调整为`DetailTemplate`+`area-overview-wrapper`并排，`stat-column`三列flex布局（`gap:12px`），统一宽度`560px`、图片`max-width:340px;height:180px;object-fit:cover`，样式块转`scoped lang="scss"`。

memories.title: ECharts主渲染中同步setOption告警
memories.content: `renderFundTrendMixed`在`index.vue`约767行于ECharts `finished`事件同步调用`chart.setOption`，触发主流程告警。改用`requestAnimationFrame`推迟调用，以`lastTrendUnitPos`缓存位置防循环，并为graphic更新设`{replaceMerge:['graphic']}`。
